data.desc: Rimini Street, Inc. (Nasdaq: RMNI), a Russell 2000 Company, is a proven, trusted global provider of end-to-end, mission-critical enterprise software support, managed services and innovative Agentic AI ERP solutions, and is the leading third-party support provider for Oracle, SAP and VMware software. The Company has signed thousands of IT service contracts with Fortune Global 100, Fortune 500, midmarket, public sector and government organizations who have leveraged the Rimini Smart Path methodology to achieve better operational outcomes, billions of US dollars in savings and fund AI and other innovation.
